about: Tardeo is one of South Mumbai's most quietly distinguished localities. Flanked by the iconic Haji Ali Dargah to the west, Breach Candy and Pedder Road to the south, Grant Road to the north and Mahalaxmi to the east, it occupies a uniquely central and prestigious position in the city. Its tree-lined roads, heritage buildings and proximity to two of India's finest hospitals make it one of Mumbai's most sought-after addresses. character_vibe_description: Character & Vibe An honest snapshot - the energy, the people, the pace. The kind of thing no other directory tells you. Tardeo is South Mumbai at its most balanced. It has the prestige of Pedder Road without the exclusivity, the heritage of Grant Road without the density, and the sea access of Marine Lines without the price tag. It is a neighbourhood that has always attracted people who know what they want - a good address, good hospitals nearby, good schools for the children and a quiet life. The Haji Ali Dargah gives Tardeo a spiritual anchor that no other South Mumbai neighbourhood has. Every Thursday evening, the causeway fills with devotees of every faith - a reminder that this is a city that has always found its own way to coexist. The Parsi families of Tardeo Road, the Gujarati business families of Nana Chowk and the young professionals of Bhulabhai Desai Road all share the same streets with a quiet, mutual respect.

resident_profile_description: Resident Profile A distinguished cross-section of South Mumbai - here's who you'll find calling Tardeo home. Tardeo draws a fascinating mix of old South Mumbai families and new-age professionals. Parsi families have lived on Tardeo Road for generations, maintaining their buildings and community halls with quiet pride. Gujarati business families of Nana Chowk have been here for decades. Young professionals drawn by the South Mumbai address and the proximity to Breach Candy and Jaslok hospitals make up a growing segment. And the Muslim community around Haji Ali adds a spiritual and cultural dimension that is uniquely Tardeo.

faq.question: What is Tardeo known for?
faq.answer: Tardeo is known for the iconic Haji Ali Dargah - one of Mumbai's most visited spiritual landmarks - as well as being one of South Mumbai's most prestigious residential addresses, home to Breach Candy Hospital, Jaslok Hospital, and the leafy, quiet lanes that connect Grant Road to Pedder Road and Mahalaxmi.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Tardeo?
faq.answer: Tardeo uses the pin code 400007, shared with the adjacent Grant Road and Gamdevi areas.

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Tardeo?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Tardeo are Haji Ali, August Kranti Marg, Nana Chowk, Tardeo Road, Mahalaxmi fringe, Bhulabhai Desai Road, and the Breach Candy belt.

faq.question: What is the property price in Tardeo?
faq.answer: Property prices in Tardeo range from ₹3 Cr for a 2BHK in the Nana Chowk belt to ₹6–12 Cr for a 2BHK on Tardeo Road or Bhulabhai Desai Road, and ₹12 Cr+ for premium sea-facing or high-floor apartments near Haji Ali. Rental rates range from ₹55,000 to ₹2 lakh per month (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Tardeo?
faq.answer: Tardeo is primarily served by taxis and private cars. The nearest Western Railway stations are Grant Road (10 min walk) and Charni Road (12 min walk). BEST bus routes 1, 83, 106, 132 serve the area. The Bandra-Worli Sea Link is accessible via Haji Ali in 10 minutes.

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Tardeo?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Tardeo include Breach Candy Hospital, Jaslok Hospital, Wockhardt Hospital, Saifee Hospital, and Bhatia General Hospital.

faq.question: Which schools are in Tardeo?
faq.answer: Notable schools in Tardeo include Campion School, Greenlawns High School, Walsingham House School, Bharda New High School, and Children's Academy.
